question: When was the Regional Climate Centre Network Task Team Meeting held in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**June 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Regional Climate Centre (RCC) Network Task Team Meeting** is a significant international gathering scheduled to be hosted in **India** in **June 2025**.
 
• This meeting serves as a technical platform under the **World Meteorological Organization (WMO)** to streamline the operations of various climate centers across the globe.
 
• The primary objective of the meeting is to review the current status of the **RCC Network** and ensure that climate services are delivered efficiently to the **National Meteorological and Hydrological Services (NMHSs)** of member nations.
 
• Hosting this meeting in **India** underscores the nation's pivotal role in **South Asian meteorology** and its commitment to global climate monitoring and disaster preparedness.
